title: Delegation brief
description: A brief as `brief new` writes it (template tools/agents/brief-template.md): a title, metadata bullets under it (`- id: ...`, the keys lowercased, read before the first `##` heading), then the sections. The header is validated here; the sections file lists the required sections (case-insensitive, matched by title prefix like the delegation lint), which depend on the kind: implement, job and skeleton briefs carry the contract-first sections.

model.description: The model first, then why (an escalation says why).

working directory.description: Absolute path of the worktree or checkout.

write scope.description: `read-only`, or the files and folders the agent may change (comma separated).

budget.description: Expected size, for example about 30 turns; the agent stops and reports past it.

sizing.description: The product's sizing.md, for a product unit.

depends.description: Catalog contract ids (or a Batuta contract id such as C02) this unit depends on.
